rules.statement: The appointment of a legal representative under the Mortgage Ordinance was invalid where there was no evidence that the mortgaged property was under Rs. 2,500 in value.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the only evidence for the appointment of a legal representative under section 7 of the Mortgage Ordinance was that the deceased mortgagor died leaving an estate under Rs. 2,500 in value- Held , that in the absence of specific violence that the mortgaged property was under Rs. 2,500 in value the appointment of the legal repetitive and though Fiscal�s sale, thereafter, of the mortgaged property were of no avail.
